question: to the Commission Gerolf Annemans (PfE) Subject:

Regulation No 1/1958 and Article 24 TFEU guarantee the use of the official languages of the Union. At the same time, the Commission recognises that specialised, urgent or short-term web content is not always available in all 24 official languages and that all content is published at least in English. As a result, information may be available in English before it is available in Dutch. 1.
Does the Commission systematically monitor the time lag between the publication of English and Dutch versions of public information?
What objective criteria does the Commission apply when publishing public information in only a limited number of official languages?
Does the Commission regard machine translation as a fully-fledged alternative to a Dutch-language version that has been checked for accuracy?
